summary.text: Father of Leïtus and Clonius, the Boeotian captains whom Hyginus names as sons of Lacritus and Cleobule (`cleobule-boeotian`) — Homer names only Alectryon as father of Leïtus.

story.text: In Hyginus' muster-roll Leïtus leads twelve Boeotian ships and Clonius nine, both sons of Lacritus and Cleobule from Boeotia.
